title: The emergence of pottery in Africa during the tenth millennium cal BC: new evidence from Ounjougou (Mali)
lineage: University of Geneva scan of the original field study. The 2020 synthesis discusses the same HA1 finds.

passages.locator: pp. 909–911, HA1 formation and assemblage; Figs. 1 and 3
passages.note: The sherds were redeposited in fluvial unit HA1, under dated units. HA1 itself could not be directly dated. The assemblage includes a bowl fragment and a decorated body fragment.

A few earlier or contemporary African comparisons have possible but problematic associations. Grass exploitation is an environmental and technological interpretation, not an identification of vessel contents.
